n: Capriasca 30-Inch Freestanding French Door Gas Range, 4 Burners, Convection Oven, Energy Efficient
desc: The 30 Inch Forno Capriasca French Door Gas Range blends professional style and durability with its Black design. Featuring unique french doors for extra oven access space, a rangetop delivering 100,000 BTU with 5 dual-ring brass burners, and heavy-duty cast iron grates over a recessed enamel cooking surface for easy cleaning.
hl: Experience peace of mind with FORNO products, each backed by a 2-year warranty covering labor and parts, ensuring satisfaction and confidence in the reliability of our high-quality appliances.
